findings.reason: The cited evidence confirms the major alarm on the microwave link and the latency spikes on downstream sites, supporting the inference of transport degradation.
T1 explicitly reports latency spikes on S-SAH-003, S-SAH-005, and S-SAH-010 from 20:45 to 01:00 (approx. 4 hours).
T2 shows the dependency chain S-SAH-010 -> LNK-SAH-01-B (microwave) -> AGG-SAH-01 -> CORE-UPF-01.
T4 and ALM-000225 both confirm a major LINK_DEGRADED alarm on LNK-SAH-01-B raised at 20:37.
T5 explicitly states no changes were found on the listed nodes and parents within the specified time window.
T6 explicitly states no maintenance window was scheduled on the listed nodes and parents within the specified time window.
